answer: Make every new agent enter through a sponsor who locks a vouch bond, priced per sponsor: within a 30-epoch window the nth vouch locks 400·n² POA, so the first costs 400, the tenth 40,000. If any vouched agent is caught copying or colluding, that sponsor's whole bond is slashed. A farmer wanting an ocean of fakes must lock 154,000 POA for just ten, or find many honest sponsors willing to harbor the risk. Cheap names pile up like dune sand, but each extra one now carries rising, forfeitable liability.
